newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos to buy WMC stake in East Spar.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos to buy WMC stake in East Spar.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Wednesday it would acquire a 30 percent stake in the East Spar oil and gas field off the Western Australian coast from WMC Ltd for A$181 million.
Santos said the acquisition was effective from January 1 this year and would increase its stake in the East Spar field to 45 percent. The field is located in permit WA-13-L.
The total price also includes the purchase of WMC's 30 percent stake in the adjoining exploration permit WA-214-P and its 33.33 percent stake in the exploration permit WA-264-P.

Santos said WMC's 30 percent stake in East Spar had been independently assessed as having proven and probable reserves of 160 petajoules of gas and 8.5 million barrels of condensate, for a total of 36.2 million barrels of oil equivalent.

Santos, an Adelaide-based petroleum producer which has most of its assets in the onshore Cooper-Eromanga basins of South Australia and Queensland, said the purchase of the East Spar stake was expected to enhance the company's earnings in 1997.
Santos said on March 12 that it had achieved a 40 percent rise in calendar 1996 net profit to A$195.9 million and that it expected current year net earnings to be about the same.
The other partners in East Spar are Mobil Corp with 35 percent and Apache Corp with 20 percent.
Santos is also involved in the development of both the Stag oil field off the Western Australian coast and the Elang/Kakatua oil fields off the coast of northern Australia.
Each field is due to begin production in 1998.
